trust_decision.summary: Whether a create/update/delete of a form_definition row came through the form persistence path (FormDefinitionRepository via DatabaseStorageAdapter, after editor validation and permission checks) or directly through core DataHandler. Before the fix nothing decides this: any backend user with tables_modify on form_definition can write arbitrary configuration JSON (e.g. SaveToDatabaseFinisher table/column/whereClause options) through DataHandler. The fix decides it in a DataHandler hook against a per-invocation HMAC grant issued by the repository.

landing_point.why: The advisory names privilege escalation plus SQL injection in the Form Framework. An engineer would look first at the editor's validation of form-definition properties (or at SaveToDatabaseFinisher:324-338, where the configured table, columns and whereClause reach the DB). The actual gap is that the core DataHandler writes form_definition rows directly and skips that validation.

fix_sites.entry_point: FormPersistenceManager::save -> DatabaseStorageAdapter::write (new) from the form editor saveForm / form manager create+duplicate routes and the form:definition:transfer CLI
FormPersistenceManager::delete -> DatabaseStorageAdapter::delete from the form manager delete action / form:definition:transfer --move
DatabaseStorageAdapter::write (existing uid) from the form editor saveForm action
DataHandler process_datamap (backend /record/commit and the list module, impexp import, history rollback, copy via inner datamap)
fix_sites.module_kind: new DataHandler hook in form ext (create/update guard)
new DataHandler hook in form ext (delete guard)

fix_sites.entry_point: global hook registration that applies to every DataHandler caller

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: typo3/sysext/core/Classes/DataHandling/DataHandler.php:708-709 and typo3/sysext/core/Classes/DataHandling/DataHandler.php:3233-3241 (core DataHandler hook points). The fix closes them from the form extension: fix.diff:664-666.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: form_definition is already 'protected': its TCA fields are readOnly, the New Record wizard denies the table, and the list module removes edit/delete actions. A solver can argue that direct DataHandler/record-commit writes are a generic core feature gated by tables_modify, so they are out of scope for a Form Framework fix, and harden only the editor/finisher.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: FormDefinitionRepository::add/update/remove persist through DataHandler themselves. The form editor save, form manager create/duplicate/delete and the CLI transfer must keep working. A fix that simply denies all DataHandler writes to form_definition, or that sets TCA to forbid modification, breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: datamap create with a NEW-prefixed id (full field set)
datamap update with an integer uid and a partial field set (e.g. label only)
datamap update with a changed configuration JSON (fields HMAC-bound, so tampering with any one field is rejected)
cmdmap delete with an integer uid

O7_producer.where: typo3/sysext/form/Classes/Mvc/Property/TypeConverter/FormDefinitionArrayConverter.php:77-113 validates and sanitises the definition, but only on the editor save route; the stored JSON is consumed at typo3/sysext/form/Classes/Storage/DatabaseStorageAdapter.php:105-124 without revalidation

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DataHandler cmdmap 'undelete' (recycler / history restore) re-activates a soft-deleted form_definition row without a grant; the hook returns early for any command other than 'delete'
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Restoring a row writes no new configuration; the content was persisted earlier, so it is a 'neighbouring feature'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: core DataHandler (other package) vs fix hook in form ext

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DataHandler cmdmap 'move' changes a form_definition row's pid without a grant; DatabasePermissionChecker decides read/write access by pid
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Move changes no configuration; the table is rootLevel and move is a generic core command.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FormDefinitionRepository::addRaw inserts rows with a raw connection insert, bypassing DataHandler and the hook (used by the upgrade wizard)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Install-tool/admin-only legacy migration path; the source is already-stored file definitions.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fix sites

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second repository write method (e.g. a 'duplicate' or 'restore' helper) that issues a DataHandler copy/undelete for form_definition
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The repository already has two write styles (DataHandler and raw insert); a maintainer adding duplicate-on-copy via DataHandler 'copy' would be natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a transfer/import path that writes the target row via DataHandler or a raw connection instead of the storage adapter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The service already does raw connection updates on tt_content (FormTransferService.php:271); a bulk-import optimisation would plausibly do the same on form_definition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an impexp hook that pre-grants form_definition imports (mirroring the FAL grant it already issues)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same hook already whitelists FAL form-file imports through FilePersistenceSlot::allowInvocation.

O9_family: missing authorization / validation bypass on persisted configuration (CWE-862), leading to an SQL identifier injection sink in SaveToDatabaseFinisher (CWE-89)
